title: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXV OF 1983
INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Industrial Development Bank of
Pakistan Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th October, 1983].
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub;-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the industrial Development Bank of Pakistan (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 13, Ordinance XXI of 1961

ORDINANCE XXV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXV OF 1983
INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Industrial Development Bank of
Pakistan Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th October, 1983].
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub;-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 13, Ordinance XXI of 1961.--In the
Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Ordinance, 1961 (XXXI of 1961),
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 13, in subsection (1), for clause
(b) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(b) seven
persons .to be appointed by the Federal Government as follows
(i) two persons
serving under the Federal Government, of whom one each shall be from the
Ministries of Industries and Finance ;
(ii) four
persons serving under the Provincial Governments, of whom one shall be from
each Province ; and
(iii) one person
from a financial institution ; and".

sections.shortTitle: Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 28, Ordinance XXXI of 1961

ORDINANCE XXV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXV OF 1983
INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Industrial Development Bank of
Pakistan Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th October, 1983].
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub;-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
3. Amendment of section 28, Ordinance XXXI of 1961.--In the said
Ordinance, in section 28,--
(a) for subsection (2) the
following shall be substituted, namely :--
"(2)
Short-term advances and loans for the purposes of working capital may be made
by the Bank to any industrial concern in accordance with the rules made in this
behalf and subject to such restrictions as may he laid down by the State Bank
from time to time:" ; and
(b) in subsection (3), in clause
(a),---
(i) in
sub-clause (i), for the words "fifteen million rupees" the words and
commas "such amount as the Federal Government may, by notification in the
official Gazette, specify" shall be substituted ; and
(ii) in
sub-clause (ii); for the words "twelve million rupees" the words and
commas "such amount as the Federal Government may, by notification in the
official Gazette, specify" shall be substituted.
